name: Iron-gated gap beside Costa
observations: Narrow open gap between Costa and Josiah Hincks side wall.
Tall black vertical iron gate/fence with pointed/slim bars frames entry.
Brick end walls and side elevations are visible; a glimpse behind gate does not establish full passage destination.
Retain depth and separation rather than joining the two storefronts into one wall.
Gate can be a closed placeholder; gameplay door decision is separate from photographic geometry.
unknowns: Exact dimensions, rear elevation and interior layout are not established. Street View address is a camera label, not this unit address.
